about: The tool's own clip index, shipped inside the tool. "glossary" explains the parts that recur in the game's clip names (family prefixes, stances, speeds, directions and the like). "clips" gives readable names and categories for clips whose use is known: "who" plays a clip and "what" it is, in the tool's category words; the tool shows these as "from the tool's list", after what the game's own graph says on the user's PC. The file holds nothing of the game's but clip IDs and name parts; every description is the tool's own. A glossary entry's "search", where it stands, gives the words the search looks in for that part instead of the head of its meaning (the words before a colon, semicolon or bracket, when they are three or fewer); several such words are a phrase, which a search finds by its last word, alone or beside any other, and by the words before it only together with the last ("left shoulder": shoulder finds it, left alone doesn't). An entry with "sure": false is kept for maintainers to check and is never shown or searched; "note" is for maintainers and is never shown.
